findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: The test strips that were available at the facility were the incorrect strips for testing sanitizer concentrations. The strips were for testing pH levels. Demonstrated how to properly test sanitizer solutions with the PIC. Ensure that quaternary ammonia test strips are available to properly test sanitizer concentrations. Will follow-up on 1/6/2025 to ensure that test strips are available.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.
